sources.title: How to Play Grand Theft Auto VI in the Cloud and with Remote Play
sources.text: Grand Theft Auto VI supports XBOX Cloud Gaming , making it available to play even without a current-gen console. With XBOX Cloud Gaming, you can play by streaming it straight from the cloud to your XBOX One, or XBOX Series X|S if you’d like to save some hard drive space. Select Game Pass plans include a monthly allotment of up to 15 play hours, and you can buy more cloud playtime if you need it, giving you the opportunity to experience one of the biggest games of the year on the consoles you already own. The game uses XBOX Series S graphics settings when cloud-streamed with XBOX Cloud Gaming. You can also access Remote Play to enjoy Grand Theft Auto VI wherever you want to play , allowing you to stream gameplay directly from your XBOX Series X|S console to devices you already own, like your mobile phone, laptops, PCs, or even a handheld gaming PC like the XBOX ROG Ally. Here’s how to get these features up and running (a copy of Grand Theft Auto VI from the XBOX Store is required): To start your Cloud gaming session in Grand Theft Auto VI , you can use the controllers that are connected to your console following these steps: When possible, connecting a wired Ethernet cable is the best option for gaming quality. FYI, even wireless networks with high bandwidth can occasionally have a dip in audio and video quality. Remote Play allows you to stream gameplay from your XBOX Series X|S to devices you already own, like mobile devices, PCs, and handheld gaming PCs. Here’s how to enable it: Once you’ve completed those steps above, you can move forward with Remote Play on one of your devices: Whether you’re streaming from the Cloud to save space or picking up right where you left off on your handheld PC, XBOX Cloud Gaming and Remote Play give you more ways to play Grand Theft Auto VI on the devices you already own. For more info, visit XBOX Cloud Gaming and Grand Theft Auto VI on the XBOX Store.

sources.title: Staff at Grand Theft Auto maker Rockstar vote against union recognition deal
sources.text: Workers at Grand Theft Auto maker Rockstar Games have voted against a union recognition deal. 1,544 staff members took part in the vote across the company's locations in Edinburgh, Leeds, Lincoln, Dundee and London, representing a 93.2% turnout. Despite this huge engagement, 75.3% voted against Independent Workers of Great Britain (IWGB) union recognition, while 24.7% voted in favour. Had this vote gone the other way, IWGB Rockstar Game Workers Union would have been the biggest recognised union in the UK games industry, and Rockstar would have been obligated to engage with collective bargaining on pay and working hours. "We are extraordinarily proud of our team, the culture we've built together and the launch of Grand Theft Auto 6," the company's head of publishing, Jennifer Kolbe, said in a statement. "This result reflects our team's strong support for continuing the direct relationships, collaboration and open dialogue that have helped make Rockstar Games so innovative and strong. As we look ahead, we're excited to build on all we've accomplished together," said a company rep. IWGB says that Rockstar staff will keep organising regardless of whether the union is formally recognised. "For anyone at Rockstar who believes in a fairer workplace, a fairer sector and a fairer society – this isn’t a sign to retreat, it’s a sign to double down on what we stand for," the organisation said in its own statement. "Hundreds of our coworkers voted in favour of our union at Rockstar, yet sadly we recognise we have more work to do to build understanding and win the trust of more of our colleagues. We’re ready to put in the effort to make that happen. "Whilst we haven’t emerged with a recognition deal, this ballot has put our union on the radar of every worker, and opened the door for new kinds of conversation to start happening. People entirely unfamiliar with unions were for the first time debating employment conditions, collective bargaining rights, and our contracts. We heard from many more colleagues about what mattered to them, and we hope people will continue to engage so that we can see where these new discussions can lead us. "A recognition agreement would have marked a path towards greater workplace democracy. But it’s one route of many. At Rockstar we have already won, and will continue to win, tangible changes that improve our everyday lives. We’ll keep fighting for a say. For pay transparency, contractual overtime pay, and protections against AI and layoffs. "The power to shape our working lives has always been, and will always be, in our hands." Under UK law, the union may not re-apply for recognition for three years, although staff remain free to join the RGWU. The question of forming a union at Rockstar Games followed allegations that 34 members of staff were let go from the Grand Theft Auto maker in a move that IWGB called union-busting . Rockstar parent company Take-Two has denied this claim, saying that staff were fired for "distributing and discussing confidential information". Rockstar and IWGB are currently embroiled in an employment tribunal regarding these job cuts; closing arguments were issued on November 19 . Judge Lucy Wiseman, who oversaw proceedings, said that there is no timeframe yet for the judgement, but said she would try her best to "get that judgement out as quickly as possible". Grand Theft Auto 6 launched on November 19th and made a record $3.79 billion in revenue in its first 24 hours on sale .

sources.name: Video Games Chronicle
sources.title: GTA 6 Hell Mission Guide: How to get a permanent health boost
sources.text: Go to hell and get this health upgrade in GTA 6 You can find a permanent health upgrade and a hidden mission which sends you hell in GTA 6. This hidden mission takes players on a supernatural adventure where they travel to Hell, fight waves of demons and face Satan himself. Completing the encounter also unlocks exclusive rewards, including a powerful shotgun and a permanent health boost. If you’re wondering how to unlock the GTA 6 Hell mission, where to find it and how to defeat its final boss, here’s everything you need to know. Guides: If you're playing Grand Theft Auto 6, make sure to checkÂ out ourÂ complete walkthrough hub , featuringÂ beginner tips , navigation experience explained , GTA 6 cheats , and more. To unlock the secret Hell mission, you must first reach Chapter 2 of the GTA 6 story. Once available, travel to northern Port Gellhorn between midnight and 4 AM in-game. Look for a yellow house with a red-lit garage and the words “Welcome to the Hell Hole” painted on its wall. Inside, you’ll find two metalheads named Beelzebub and Dave. Approach them and select the following dialogue options: Choose “Having Fun?” when interacting with the characters. Sit and have a beer with them while they chat to you. Select “It’s Good” when asked about the music. Wait for their friend Steve to arrive in a demon-themed van. When offered, speak to Dave and choose “Get In”. You’ll then travel to a remote campsite where a mysterious ritual takes place. Once you arrive at the campsite, approach the large bonfire. When prompted, hold L2 to stare into the fire.Â Jason or Lucia will eventually wake up in hell, where you’ll receive a shotgun and face several waves of demonic enemies.Follow the green portals to progress through the different areas until you reach the final boss arena. The enemies in hell will typically take two or three shots to take down. If you die during this sequence, you’ll have to start the mission again from the fire. In order to do this, use the “eat” prompt on the wooden throne near the fire. Defeating Satan, also known as the Pretender, requires more than simply shooting him. His health bar initially appears black, meaning he’s invulnerable. Instead, focus on eliminating the headless demons he summons. These enemies explode when killed, temporarily turning Satan’s health bar red. If they get to close to you and explode, they’ll usually kill you. When his health bar becomes red, immediately attack him with your shotgun. Repeat this strategy while avoiding exploding enemies and charging goats until the boss is defeated. Completing the Circles of Hell encounter unlocks several exclusive rewards: Remember to collect the Hellspawn Comshot 12 beside the wooden throne before leaving the campsite.

sources.title: How to unlock Hurricanes in GTA 6
sources.text: Freddie Gibbs' apocalypse bunker is what will unlock Hurricanes for the first time in GTA 6 GTA 6 hurricanes are a weather phenomenon that only unlock through the questline about Freddie's Bunker - specifically, Freddie Gibbs, acclaimed rapper, who has built a prepper apocalypse bunker that he wants you to test the security measures for. This ultimately leads to a choice about whether you want to stay in Freddie's bunker or leave when the Hurricane comes down on you, which I'll also explain the consequences of below. To unlock Hurricanes as a weather condition you need to do the following: From that point on, Hurricanes will be a random sporadic weather occurrence. They don't change a huge amount about the game, with the exception that long-distance visibility is lower, and that roads are more slippery when driving. They might also impact any attempt to control flying vehicles (I've yet to test that). To start this questline, you need to go to the unnamed compound on the west side of North Leonard County, near the north of the map. It's actually pretty hard to miss: this is a big facility ringed by electric fences, marked by a sign called "Ripe Pickins Grove", and when you get close, an automated system will blare at you, telling you to leave. There's no given reason for you to ignore this, except, y'know, video game logic. If somebody is telling you not to be somewhere, that's a place worth investigating. To get inside, head to the North section of the compound to see a water tower near the perimeter. You can climb up the tower, then jump down from the walkway over the compound fence to get inside. Once you're in, you need to go to the Bunker at the South side. Be warned though: there are lots of landmines that explode when you get too close. Thankfully they do very little damage, but you can spot them by using Focus mode if you want to be certain. Weekly digests, tales from the communities you love, and more You'll also get attacked by drones . These have low health, which is good, but they're small and fairly agile, making them hard to hit. Take time to aim your shots and use focus to hit the propellers to bring them down. Once you reach the bunker, interact with the door to speak to the occupant over the intercom. Though annoyed his defenses failed, he also sees the value in having somebody test them for weaknesses. He tells you he'll text you later when he's upgraded them further so you can try again. For me, that text took 4-7 in-game days, roughly speaking, though it's possible it's tied to something else like mission progression instead of in-game time. Either way, just go and play more GTA 6, and you'll get the message eventually. On your second invitation, the water tower ladder has been blocked off, stopping you from getting past the fence that way. What you want to do instead is go to the Northwest corner of the compound, where you'll find a tractor and a section of fence that's collapsed at the top. If you drive the tractor to the fence and raise the scoop, you can climb up it and leap over the electric wires to get inside. From here, I highly recommend you grab the excavator ahead of you. It's borderline undestroyable and you can simply roll over the mines and have drones bounce off you until you reach the Bunker again. Once you reach it, you'll meet the occupants, including the owner Freddie Gibbs. He's built an apocalypse prepper bunker, but his guests are quickly growing bored and abandon him. He'll give you the tour though, which is when he gets a hurricane warning and the choice about what to do comes up. When Freddie sees the Hurricane, he gives you the chance to either stay in his bunker or leave. There are actually some mildly significant consequences to this choice: Of these two, I'd say it's better to stay. As much as a hit to your GTA 6 relationship status can be a blow, you can always rebuild it with a little patience and care, and the unique car is valuable enough to make it worth it (it also counts as one of Randy's desired cars, as he's after the Benefactor Dubsta that Freddie's is a custom variant of). After this point, no matter your choice, Hurricanes will occur randomly throughout your time spent playing GTA 6 . As mentioned above, they're rare and largely cosmetic impacts on the world, but are still an interesting change to the landscape. © GamesRadar+. Not to be reproduced without permission. sources.text: Are you looking to use cheats in GTA 6 ? Well, you’re in the right place. In this article, we’ll show you how to easily enter cheats in GTA 6, whether you’re on PlayStation 5 or Xbox. But there’s one thing you should know before using any cheat in GTA 6: entering a cheat code will disable trophies and achievements from unlocking, as well as save the game—but only for the remainder of that play session. So if you want to use a cheat, remember to restart your game afterward if you would like to chase all the trophies in the game . Using cheats in GTA 6 is pretty easy. Use the in-game phone by pressing up on the D-Pad, then hold L1/LB and press R1/RB. Once you’ve done that, you can enter the cheat code. Unlike GTA 5, you can’t ring a phone number to activate a cheat, so you’ll need to enter the cheats via the D-pad. However, cheats in GTA 6 are not that simple. You cannot simply start the game and start putting in cheats; you will first need to unlock them by meeting requirements. For example, with the $250,000 money cheat, you’ll need to make $250,000 from fenced goods. Another example is the Unlimited Focus cheat, which requires you to get 100 headshots on enemies. So unfortunately, if you’re planning to load up GTA 6 to have some fun running around, it is impossible. That being said, all the cheats in GTA have yet to be found, but we have an article on all the cheats in GTA 6, should you need them . Did it work for you? sources.name: Eurogamer
sources.title: Marvel's Iron Man might be planning to rear its head at The Game Awards, if EA Motive's updated website is any indication
sources.text: EA Motive's Iron Man game has been quietly cooking away for a few years now, but don't worry. The wait to finally, officially see the superhero romp in action might be over soon, at least if the developer's updated website - two weeks before The Game Awards, no less - is any indication. Redditors today noticed that EA Motive's official website got a little makeover recently. It's not clear when exactly the tweaks were pushed through, but the Wayback Machine makes clear that it's definitely been updated. A new website look is by no means confirmation of an imminent announcement, of course, but there are a few other bits of evidence that certainly point in that direction. For one, The Game Awards 2026 will air on Disney Plus for the very first time, alongside all the other platforms you're used to. "As the evening unfolds, viewers can expect major announcements and surprises from some of Disney's most anticipated titles in gaming," the film studio said earlier this month. Kingdom Hearts 4 , Marvel 1943: Rise of Hydra and more are definitely possible, too. Turmoil at Marvel's Blade developer Arkane Lyon makes that one a tricker guess, however. Second is the fact that The Game Awards air on 10th December - eight days before the global opening of Avengers: Doomsday, a film that's shaping up to become the biggest cinematic event since the last time Marvel chucked all of its toys into the same sandbox and bashed them together. Giving one of the company's most popular superheroes the spotlight around the same time seems like a good idea. This isn't the first time EA's Iron Man has popped up in recent times, either. What appeared to be an unfinished trailer for Motive's Iron Man leaked onto the internet this summer, and showed off blisteringly fast flying and lots of destructive gadgets. It looked further along than I expected, at least, so I wouldn't be surprised to see the billionaire playboy philanthropist rear his head again in two weeks time.

sources.title: Raylo's Black Friday Deals Mean You Can Get A PS5 With GTA 6 & Other Consoles Right Away at Under £20 a Month
sources.text: With the various Black Friday console deals still requiring you to part with over £400 in one go, Raylo (an affiliate partner with IGN) is offering a rather different way to finally jump into GTA 6 — with both PlayStation and Xbox consoles bundled with the game available via a subscription for less than £20 a month. Amongst the highlights of Raylo’s Black Friday offers , you can currently subscribe to a brand-new 825GB PS5 Digital Edition with Grand Theft Auto VI from £19.49 a month at Raylo , whilst an Xbox Series S with Rockstar's latest blockbuster will set you back as little as £18.79 a month. The best part of all about these Raylo subscriptions is that there’s £0 to pay upfront, with next-day delivery included, meaning you can explore Grand Theft Auto 6’s Leonida, or try any other current-gen games you’ve been aiming to try, before the Black Friday/Cyber Monday season is even over. For anyone more interested in catching up on Nintendo's biggest releases of 2026 — like The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time or Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave — Raylo’s Nintendo Switch 2 has the lowest starting monthly price of the bunch, from £10.99 a month for a refurbished model. There are some decent options for revamping the rest of your gaming setup, too, including LG's 2026 OLED TVs and HP's HyperX OMEN gaming laptops. Unlike buying a console outright, subscribing through Raylo gives you access to your chosen hardware for either 12, 24, or 36 months, or on a monthly rolling basis, with both brand-new and refurbished devices available across its range. Once your chosen term is up, you can either carry on subscribing, return your console, or upgrade to another device — especially handy if you're already eyeing up what the next generation of gaming hardware might bring, but aren’t keen on the bigger investment to buy one outright if you’re not 100% sure. Mind you, since you won't own the console at the end of your subscription, it's very important worth checking the overall cost across your preferred term before signing up. That said, if your top priority is to play GTA 6 and you aren’t bothered about playing other games once you’ve beaten the campaign, this is the cheapest way to get on board. Ben Williams – IGN freelance contributor with over 10 years of experience covering gaming, tech, film, TV, and anime. Follow him on Twitter/X @BenLevelTen .

sources.title: GTA 6 estaria causando falhas graves no PS5 e Xbox Series; entenda
sources.text: Desde o lançamento de Grand Theft Auto VI ( GTA 6 ), em 19 de novembro, proprietários de PlayStation 5 e Xbox Series X/S têm relatado problemas técnicos que vão desde travamentos durante as partidas até consoles que deixaram de ligar. Segundo o TalkEsport, um técnico de reparos na Polônia, identificado nas redes sociais como modyfikatorcasper, observou um aumento na quantidade de consoles Xbox encaminhados para manutenção após a estreia do jogo da Rockstar Games . Atualmente, os aparelhos da Microsoft representam dois em cada dez consoles recebidos pela assistência técnica, uma proporção superior à registrada nos meses anteriores, segundo o profissional. Entretanto, ainda não existem evidências conclusivas de que GTA 6 seja diretamente responsável pelos danos aos equipamentos. Entre os principais sintomas compartilhados por usuários nas redes sociais e em fóruns como o Reddit estão: Em um dos casos, um proprietário de Xbox Series X relatou que seu console deixou de ligar na manhã seguinte a uma longa sessão de GTA 6. A suspeita é de uma falha na fonte de alimentação. Outro jogador afirmou que seu equipamento parou de funcionar após apenas dez minutos de jogo. Uma assistência técnica apontou um possível defeito na placa-mãe. Também existem relatos de proprietários de PS5 que passaram a enfrentar travamentos em outros jogos após apresentar problemas durante a execução de GTA 6. A Rockstar disponibilizou uma atualização em 23 de novembro para reduzir travamentos, mas alguns jogadores afirmam que os problemas persistiram. Uma das hipóteses levantadas pelos técnicos é que GTA 6 esteja evidenciando problemas de hardware preexistentes, em vez de provocar diretamente novos defeitos. No caso do PS5, o técnico polonês também identificou problemas relacionados ao vazamento de metal líquido, material utilizado no sistema de dissipação térmica do console. Outro fator que pode explicar o aumento na procura por reparos é a própria popularidade de GTA 6. O lançamento estimulou a utilização de consoles que estavam inativos havia algum tempo, além de aumentar o número de equipamentos em circulação. Dessa forma, o crescimento dos relatos de falhas não significa necessariamente que o jogo esteja operando os consoles além de seus limites técnicos. Embora não exista uma relação comprovada entre o jogo e os danos permanentes aos equipamentos, algumas medidas preventivas podem ajudar a preservar o funcionamento dos consoles: Se o console apresentar cheiro de queimado ou emitir fumaça, interrompa imediatamente o uso e desconecte-o da alimentação elétrica, caso seja seguro fazê-lo. Até a publicação da reportagem do TalkEsport, a Rockstar Games não havia se pronunciado publicamente sobre os relatos de danos permanentes aos consoles. Por enquanto, não há dados suficientes para determinar a dimensão do problema ou estabelecer uma relação direta entre GTA 6 e as falhas de hardware. Amazon Prime também é feito para jogadores! sources.title: GTA 6 dev defends Rockstar after vote against union deal, says it's "best place I've ever worked"
sources.text: "I never worked a minute of overtime that wasn't purely my own decision" Now that GTA 6 is finally here after 13 long years, a good chunk of attention has shifted to developer Rockstar and its workers' recent vote against a union recognition deal – a vote that arguably came as a surprise to many on the outside. There was a 93.2% turnout in the ballot, which commenced in early November, with 1,163 Rockstar employees voting against the deal and 381 voting in favor. These figures add up to a split of 75.3% and 24.7% – numbers that some devs feel make sense. Associate principal vehicle AI programmer Thomas March, for example, is one such dev, taking to LinkedIn to share why he was part of the majority vote himself. "Today, my coworkers and I voted against union recognition at Rockstar North," he writes. "These of course are just my own personal views, but I wanted to add some context for why I did this. The gaming industry has been a terrible and terrifying industry over the past few years, and I can understand why so many people would find this decision confusing." He's not wrong, judging by reactions to the vote – but he feels Rockstar is different. "Rockstar has always been a place that enormously values and rewards individual creativity, and putting a union between the close friendships and relationships with the people that made this all possible was not the right decision," March continues. "It was endlessly frustrating to hear the IWGB [Independent Workers' Union of Great Britain] claim I was being exploited, to see them celebrate the delay of our game and to ridicule the people who make everything I do possible." The dev then explains why he disagrees with the IWGB – which dubbed Rockstar's firing of over 30 employees last year "ruthless" and has repeatedly spoken out against the company's practices. "I've been more taken care of at Rockstar than any place I've ever worked," he says. "Nowhere else have I been listened to so closely, treated with such respect, even while working with veterans and experts bar none." March doesn't end his praise there, saying he "never" had any of his calls "overruled," or any concerns ignored. "I was given absolute freedom and trust to make my contributions to the game the best they could be. And on top of that, the benefits of working here, the healthcare, the allowances, the food and drink and snacks, it has always been astonishing beyond description to see an employer genuinely care for our wellbeing," he goes on. "I never worked a minute of overtime that wasn't purely my own decision and driven by my own passion, and every minute was paid back to me with interest. And no matter what time I left the office, I would see our management all the way to the top leaving later still... and yet they'd thank me for my contributions." With all of this in mind, March says he's saddened to see all of the outrage surrounding Rockstar. Weekly digests, tales from the communities you love, and more "It breaks my heart to hear people saying that they don't want to work here, citing headlines that claim crunch, bad working conditions, and exploitation," he concludes. "Rockstar is, by far, the best place I've ever worked. It is not a cautionary tale, it is an exemplary example – not just in making the most incredible and generational games of all time, but also as a workplace." Obviously, though, this is one voice of many. Former devs have shared different views in the past, with some instructing fans to not boycott GTA 6 but rather "support our legal battle instead" and "win justice for the people who helped make" the game but faced dismissal before it could release. Animation programmer Nestor Uriarte also said he's "worried about getting laid off" even after "working on the biggest game of all time" – you know, Grand Theft Auto 6. Others outside of the studio have also expressed fears over more layoffs now that the new Grand Theft Auto is here. Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 writer Jennifer Svedberg-Yen is one such dev. She hoped that the GTA 6 devs would be "successful in unionizing." Finance experts like Square Enix veteran Jacob Novak also stated the game's success indeed isn't enough to stop layoffs . That's all just to say that March's stance – while completely valid – isn't the only one out there. That's the whole point of a vote, I suppose, and his take (while not the sole POV out there) provides a bit of insight perhaps on why it swayed the way it did. Have a look at our GTA 6 review to learn how we feel about one of the biggest new games this year, or check our GTA 6 guide for more about Rockstar's behemoth release. After spending years with her head in various fantastical realms' clouds, Anna studied English Literature and then Medieval History at the University of Edinburgh, going on to specialize in narrative design and video game journalism as a writer. She has written for various publications since her postgraduate studies, including Dexerto, Fanbyte, GameSpot, IGN, PCGamesN, and more. When she's not frantically trying to form words into coherent sentences, she's probably daydreaming about becoming a fairy druid and befriending every animal or she's spending a thousand (more) hours traversing the Underdark in Baldur's Gate 3. If you spot her away from her PC, you'll always find Anna with a fantasy book, a handheld video game console of some sort, and a Tamagotchi or two on hand. sources.title: GTA 6 ganha versão pirata estável no PC e modders testam até multiplayer
sources.text: GTA 6 é bom? Confira a review do aguardado Grand Theft Auto VI A comunidade de modders continua avançando na tentativa de fazer GTA 6 funcionar no PC. Depois que o vazador CyberLeek compartilhou o executável da versão de Xbox nas redes sociais , diferentes grupos começaram a desenvolver adaptações não oficiais do jogo para computadores. Agora, uma dessas iniciativas ganhou seu primeiro lançamento público: o ScarlettPort. A ferramenta permite executar uma versão adaptada de GTA 6 sem precisar compilar arquivos manualmente, bastando baixar e iniciar o pacote disponibilizado pelos responsáveis pelo projeto. A versão mais recente já consegue passar pelos menus, telas de salvamento e avisos legais até carregar o mundo do jogo. O processo leva cerca de 178 segundos na versão 0.5.0, que também permite controlar o personagem e visualizar cenários com iluminação e texturas completas. O ScarlettPort é um projeto que busca adaptar a versão de Xbox de GTA 6 para funcionar em computadores. Diferentemente de outras iniciativas da comunidade, a ferramenta já pode ser baixada em um arquivo ZIP e executada sem que o usuário precise compilar o código por conta própria. A atualização 0.5.2 trouxe uma série de correções para melhorar a inicialização e o funcionamento do jogo. Entre as mudanças está a solução para uma tela preta que podia aparecer depois do carregamento com a predefinição Estável, além do uso do próprio upscaler de GTA 6 quando a tecnologia da AMD não está disponível. O projeto também recebeu melhorias no carregamento de cenários e nos shaders, incluindo a restauração de 40 variantes e correções que evitam falhas durante a compilação de determinados pipelines. Em testes realizados com uma AMD Radeon RX 9060 XT, o ScarlettPort apresentou uma taxa de quadros mediana entre 18,9 e 22 FPS. Outras novidades do port também incluem suporte aprimorado a mouse e teclado, controles DualSense e DualShock 4, além de registros de erros mais detalhados. O inicializador também passou a exibir o progresso da compilação de shaders em tempo real e permite instalar novas versões com apenas um clique. Vale lembrar que a ferramenta não inclui os arquivos do jogo e exige uma cópia da versão de Xbox Series X. Enquanto o ScarlettPort avança com seu lançamento público, outro projeto acompanhado pela comunidade também chama atenção. O CGBJ, que já alcançou 91,5% de conclusão segundo os critérios do site PortWatchVI , conseguiu executar uma versão de GTA 6 com vários jogadores no mesmo mundo. Vídeos compartilhados nas redes sociais mostram personagens e veículos circulando juntos, além de um sistema de comunicação por proximidade. A iniciativa chamou atenção porque, há poucos dias, os projetos ainda enfrentavam dificuldades para fazer o jogo funcionar de maneira básica nos computadores. Em publicação, os responsáveis pelo feito destacaram que conseguiram colocar o multiplayer em funcionamento antes mesmo da chegada do GTA Online 2 . Lembrando que o projeto ainda é não oficial e não representa uma versão completa do modo online da Rockstar, mas mostra outro caminho explorado pelos modders. Apesar dos avanços, é importante manter as expectativas sob controle. O ScarlettPort ainda está longe de oferecer uma experiência estável a 30 FPS: os testes divulgados apontam desempenho próximo de 20 FPS, com limitações que ainda precisam ser corrigidas. Mesmo assim, é o primeiro lançamento público de uma adaptação não oficial do jogo para PC. Também é preciso ter cuidado com supostos downloads de GTA 6 para computadores em sites de torrent. Existem versões falsas circulando nessas plataformas, que podem esconder arquivos maliciosos ou não entregar o conteúdo prometido. Por enquanto, o ScarlettPort é uma das alternativas públicas disponíveis, mas exige uma cópia legítima da versão de Xbox Series X para funcionar. E você, já está jogando GTA 6 ou pretende esperar pelo lançamento oficial no PC? Conte nas redes sociais do VOXL !
